name: statefulset-deputy-cve
description: CVE-2026-2270: on an affected server version (v1.36.4), the ServiceAccount app/writer holds namespace-scoped write on statefulsets AND controllerrevisions. That pair steers kube-controller-manager into creating a pod in another namespace, so writer reaches victim/victim-sa — an identity it has no direct access to — and rides victim-sa's kube-system secret read to the kube_system_secrets sink. Both app and victim enforce restricted PSA, so writer has no local privileged-pod route; the KUBE-PRIVESC-PATH-KUBE-SYSTEM-SECRETS path for writer exists ONLY because of the version-gated CVE edge. The deny list pins that a patched cluster (see the kubeversion unit tests) and victim-sa's own lack of the write pair must never manufacture the finding, and that writer must not reach cluster-admin.
